Use case: scientific-educational. Create a brand NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook; all supplied images are EXTERNAL scientific mechanism references only, not edit targets or layout templates. Invent a fresh clear composition appropriate to the following objects and relations. Flat 2D technical illustration, pure #FFFFFF background and perfectly uniform solid opaque fills. Lancet muted Blue #7B95C6, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6 and Rose #C85E62 with very pale fixed white mixes. Neutral thin wires #4C4D4F. Many modules can remain white with colored outlines; restrained pale grouping only where it explains a relation. Crisp planar mechanism glyphs and accurate connections, readable blank areas. No 3D, perspective, side faces, extrusions, shadows, gloss, gradients, paper/canvas texture, noise, grain, waves, stripes, cloudy color variation or decorative card grids. At most one decorative icon per frame; equivalent frames consistently use the same or no icon. Mechanism nodes, vectors, documents and samples are allowed. NO text, letters, digits, formulas, plus/minus signs, pseudowriting, watermark or legends anywhere. Reserve adjacent or internal blank title/variable spaces; all lettering added later from actual fonts. Never put a decorative icon where a title must sit. Generous outer white margins. Landscape composition.
Scientific mechanism: Compare TWO DIFFERENT meanings of parameter distribution, separated visually by ample white space. One side: a SINGLE wide two-layer network contains MANY individual hidden neurons; each neuron corresponds to ONE parameter particle in a cloud/collection; this particle collection represents a neuron-parameter measure. The entire neuron collection contributes to an averaging/integration operation giving ONE deterministic predictor and ONE output. Individual neuron nodes should be visibly single circles, not miniature whole networks. Other side: a collection contains several WHOLE tiny neural networks as its elements, each small network has input/hidden/output connected nodes. Draw ONE selection/sample arrow from this collection to ONE selected complete network, then ONE prediction output. This depicts a posterior over complete parameter vectors; a point of that posterior is a complete network, never a single neuron. Do not connect the two distributions, do not draw empirical densities, risk curves or numbers, do not suggest they share a parameter space. Keep arrows and element-counts unambiguous. Include unobtrusive blank strips next to the individual-neuron collection, deterministic readout, full-network collection and sample operation for later labels. References contribute the mean-field element and randomized complete-network semantics, not a layout.

science_brief.title: 神经元分布与完整网络分布的两种语义
science_brief.understanding_gap: 正文用同样的分布记号语言介绍平均场与PAC-Bayes，读者容易误把一个网络的神经元集合与随机抽取完整网络混为一谈。现有平坦/尖锐曲线没有显示基本单位的差别。
proposed_mechanism: 对照一张宽网络内多个神经元参数形成ρ并通过积分得到确定性fρ；另一侧Q的每个点表示完整网络，抽一次网络再作预测。
用机制对象区别两类分布，不画经验密度或声称两者是同一参数空间。
